basic_info.description: Charming Home with Bonus Space in Prime San Francisco Location. Welcome to 249 Gaven Street! This home is located in a desirable neighborhood that blends comfort, convenience, and versatility. The main level offers a bright and functional layout with 2 bedrooms, a bathroom, refinished hardwood floors, remodeled kitchen, recessed lights; perfect for both relaxing and entertaining.    Downstairs, you'll find two spacious bonus rooms and a full bathroom with a separate entrance  ideal for a home office, guest suite, or potential income-generating space. Enjoy the outdoors in the low-maintenance backyard, perfect for weekend BBQs, family gatherings, or simply relaxing in your own private retreat. Close to parks, schools, shopping, dining, easy access to public transportation and major freeways; 249 Gaven St is a must-see! Don't miss this opportunity to own a move-in ready home in one of San Francisco's vibrant communities!
